# Edge #56
example_edge_within_var  <- 0.014
example_edge_between_var <- 0.056
# ICC = 0.056 / 0.07 = 0.8

# Total cognition
example_beh_within_var  <- 57
example_beh_between_var <- 205 
# ICC = 205 / 262 = 0.78

# Sweep over subjects and sessions
# again, let the user change the arguments, but start with:
# sample_sizes   <- seq(25, 200, by = 25)
# session_counts <- c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)

# Actual sweep
``` {}
param_grid <- expand.grid(n_subjects   = sample_sizes,
                           n_timepoints = session_counts)

results_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(param_grid)), function(i) {
  n <- param_grid$n_subjects[i]
  t <- param_grid$n_timepoints[i]

  res <- analytic_power(r_within = 0.11, r_between = 0.11, r_scale = "latent",
                         icc_x = example_edge_between_var / (example_edge_between_var + example_edge_within_var),
                         icc_y = example_beh_between_var / (example_beh_between_var + example_beh_within_var),
                         n_subjects = n,
                         n_timepoints = t,
                         within_reliability = 1,
                         y_occasion_reliability = 1)

  tibble(n_subjects   = n,
         n_timepoints = t,
         power_within  = res$power_within,
         power_between = res$power_between)
})

power_df <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(n_timepoints = factor(n_timepoints, levels = session_counts))

# Long format so within/between can be faceted
power_long <- power_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(power_within, power_between),
               names_to = "power_type",
               values_to = "power") %>%
  mutate(power_type = recode(power_type,
                              power_within  = "Within-person Power",
                              power_between = "Between-person Power"))

# Within-person power plot
p_within <- ggplot(power_df, aes(x = n_subjects, y = power_within, color = n_timepoints)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  labs(x = "Number of Subjects",
       y = "Estimated Power",
       title = "Within-Person Power by Sample Size and Number of Sessions",
       color = "Sessions") +
  ylim(0,1.0) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_classic()

# Between-person power plot
p_between <- ggplot(power_df, aes(x = n_subjects, y = power_between, color = n_timepoints)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  labs(x = "Number of Subjects",
       y = "Estimated Power",
       title = "Between-Person Power by Sample Size and Number of Sessions",
       color = "Sessions") +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_classic()
```
